item.title: Northern Lights Foundation honors Duluth East graduate with legacy grant
item.description: The Northern Lights Foundation announced the new Shimia Nord Legacy Grant, an annual $5,000 grant to honor the life and inspirational spirit of Shimia Nord, a Duluth East High School graduated who died of cancer in September 2025 at the age of 18.

item.title: Rubio plans travel to France to sell Iran war to skeptical G7 allies

item.title: Duluth Airport Authority launches donation drive for TSA staff during shutdown
item.description: The Duluth Airport Authority is launching a donation drive to support Transportation Security Administration employees at Duluth International Airport during the ongoing government shutdown.

item.title: Ahead of UConn vs. Michigan State, Hurley can't help but look to a St. John's rematch in Elite Eight
item.description: The warning comes from about every coach, every player each March — heck, in any sport as the stakes are raised as the games carry more gravitas — don’t look too far ahead. item.title: Crews respond to trailer home fire in Sandy Township

item.title: New York plane crash investigation looking at cockpit recorder and controllers
item.description: Federal investigators looking into the collision between an Air Canada jet and a fire truck at New York’s LaGuardia Airport are reviewing the cockpit voice recorder and the actions inside the control tower. The National Transportation Safety Board plans to share more details at a news conference Tuesday. The plane carrying more than 70 people slammed into the fire truck while landing late Sunday night. item.title: Delta suspends specialty services for Congress during government shutdown
